headline: The physical anomalous-U(1) generator has zero component along canonical hypercharge on the A5-organizer E8 factor and lies entirely in A4: -5/3 alpha2 -2/3 alpha3 -1/3 alpha4 -2 alpha5. Its duad-star pattern is six*Psi=(-5,3,1,-5,6), a zero-sum A4 fluctuation.
boundary: The anomalous generator also has a component in the other E8 factor; this does not construct a D/F-flat vacuum.
